title: Course Director UX UI and AI
description:
You've been designing long enough to have watched tools become essential and then disappear. You know which design skills are timeless and which ones expire.Â The human-centered design skills are where your heart is, and you know that AI will take over much of the tool-based design work soon.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

You can name theÂ ten leading designersÂ who should be teaching the worldâs best courses and Master Classes right now. You know what each of them does better than anyone else, and where their gaps are.

Now you get the opportunity to decide what hundreds of thousands of designers learn next.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes includeÂ Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman, as well as Design Leads atÂ Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe. Don Norman also chairs our executive board.

You'll be involved in the entire process of creating our courses and Master Classes, and you'll lead many of the decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you toÂ take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. Youâll be in a team with minimal distance between idea and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education

IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us take online education to new heightsÂ andÂ make a meaningful impact on humankind.

At IxDF, weâre not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

  • Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI: lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.Â This is the role described here.

  • Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI: lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.

  • Our Course Writers and Editors: lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the userâs perspective.

We're a flexible team, and you'll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

You, the Course Director, decide what belongs in our curriculum and who should teach it. You reach out to the worldâs leading experts, plan the courses with them, and shoot courses with them. When an Education Designer brings you a course outline, you're the one who says what's missing, what doesn't belong, and how to optimize the learning outcome so designers can succeed today. You'll work closely with ourÂ Co-Founder, yourÂ Team Lead, our otherÂ Course Directors, and theÂ Education Designers, and you'll plan and create courses alongside them. Our Course Writers and Editors take the finished material the last mile: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

  • Be a core part of our Editorial Team. You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create courses and Master Classes for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design.

  • You'll research what already exists in a topic area, so that what we build is genuinely unique. You'll look atÂ where design and AI are heading, what designers needÂ that nobody has taught well yet, andÂ what we should retireÂ because the field has already moved on.

  • Find the people who should teach it.Â You decide a topic is worth a course, you work out who should teach it and why, you write the email, and you get the yes. Then you plan the content with the industry leader and agree what the course must leave a learner able to do.

  • Decide what each expert should teach.Â The best designers know a great deal, and a course that tries to capture all of it becomes an information dump. You develop a point of view on what a designer genuinely needs from them, and you hold the course to it.

  • You'll decide which skills our courses teach, both to people entering design and to experienced designers leveling up. Our goal is to help designers thrive in the age of AI and work responsibly, so their users can thrive too.

  • Ensure our course participants finish each course with a solid portfolio project they can show a hiring manager.

  • Help us decide what AI should do for our course participants. Personalized learning paths, constructive AI feedback on portfolio work, practice environments where people run real design tasks and get feedback. You'll also help us improve the user flows on our own platform, so that learning at IxDF is as well designed as what we teach. You'll work on this with our founders, designers, and dev team.

  • Make an impact as you pressure-test the coursesÂ our Education Designers plan. An Education Designer sends you a course outline, and you read it against everything you know about the field and about how people learn design, then give constructive feedback on what's missing, what doesn't belong, and where the structure can be improved.Â You know the limits of your own expertise, and you research your way past them before you weigh in. You'll also plan, structure, and create courses yourself, alongside them.

  • You're one of the peopleÂ whose judgment the rest of the team leans on.Â You show our Education Designers what ten or twenty years in the field taught you to look for. In return, our Co-Founder, your Team Lead, and our other Course Directors give constructive feedback on the courses you lead. You'll work in aÂ diverse, highly organized, result-driven environmentÂ where you'll grow personally and professionally.

  • Act as guardian of our quality bar. When a course goes out under our name, it has to be better than anything else available on the topic. On the courses and Master Classes you lead or review, you're the one who spots what's not good enough yet and works with the team to fix it.

  • Bring your subject matter expertiseÂ to our writers, community managers, and social media team, so our design thinking stays consistent across everything we publish.

  • You help produce Master Classes. We produce 3 per month. Over email, you reach out to designers whose work you admire, invite them to create one with us, plan the content, and produce the live session.Â Timelines vary enormously:Â with Don Norman or Vitaly Friedman it can be two weeks from first email to publication, because we work with them often. With a new expert, it can be half a year. Once the session is recorded, you get the footage and the transcript, and you decide with the Education Designers and Team Lead which existing course benefits from which snippets, and where they go.

  • Focus on what mattersÂ as you take raw expert video material, course and Master Class transcripts and footage featuring global industry leaders, and turn it into educational material that teaches new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design. You'll work across UX design, human-computer interaction, design thinking, UI design, psychology, and AI.

  • Design for a diverse, global audience.Â Some of our courses and Master Classes serve working designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields. Often, a course will serve both in the same lesson. Getting both right without watering either down is a rewarding design challenge.

  • Give the video teamÂ constructive feedbackÂ on course and Master Class videos, from on-screen text and b-roll to graphics and animation, so each video is engaging to learn from and accurate from a design perspective.

  • Fly out and meet the global industry leaders in design in professional studios across the world.Â You'll shoot the course content there with some of your colleagues. Expect this a few times a year at minimum. Some of us love that part and join every studio production; others keep it to those few trips. Both work for us. On averageÂ we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.

  • Expect to have several courses moving at once at different stages: one you're planning with an expert, one being shot, one in production, and one published course that you're reviewing and improving.

  • Find room for improvementÂ by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios course participants produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Use the power of incremental, modular design as you help push the quality of our educational materials to new heights, surpassing even the very best in industry and academia. We're always learning, always improving, always raising the bar in everything we do and ship.

  • Maintain and improve our crystal-clear documentationÂ so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

  • We're proud to have assembledÂ a remarkable team of unicornsÂ who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

About You

  • You have at leastÂ 10 years of hands-on design experience. Thirty is not too many.

  • You have aÂ network among designers you respect, and you'reÂ comfortable writing to someone you admireÂ and presenting them with an opportunity.

  • You know what the design community wants to see, and what it needs to learn.

  • You're kind, and you have theÂ social intelligence and empathy toÂ engage well with very different kinds of people. Much of this job is convincing busy, accomplished people that what we're building is worth their time.

  • You can show us something you built or led: a product, a design team, a course, an AI teaching app, or a conference track. We're excited to hear what it was, your thinking behind it, how long it took you to create, what went wrong, and how you improved it.

  • You can take aÂ broad, complex design practice and turn it into a step-by-step learning sequenceÂ that'll make a beginner feel and act confident. You can look at a plan for teaching something andÂ see what's missingÂ before anyone builds it.

  • You're aÂ practical idealist. You know how to create great results through incremental quick wins and MVPs, and you know when to go all in and make something perfect.

  • Youâre aÂ forward thinkerÂ who isnât afraid to innovate and try new things before others have.

  • YouÂ collaborate with AI in everything you do. You use AI to research, structure, write, and create faster, and you know how to takeÂ human leadership, so theÂ outcome is 100% yoursÂ and better than you could have created without AI.

  • YouâreÂ eager to help people build UX and UI skillsÂ because you know theyâre more relevant than ever in the age of AI.

  • You canÂ teach a career changerÂ the powerful skills of great design, and you canÂ guide an experienced designerÂ in upskilling. Perhaps you've mentored people, or youâve run your own company helping clients level up.

  • YouÂ give constructive feedback people can act on, and you can tell a talented colleague how they can improve their work without them becoming defensive.

  • You're genuinelyÂ curiousÂ about how AI is changing design work and design education.

  • You'reÂ fluent in written and spoken EnglishÂ and you can explain complex ideas clearly.

  • Youâre enthusiastic about learning by doing and areÂ committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills.

  • YouÂ spot problemsÂ before anyone else notices them, and when something goes off track you come back with a solution rather than a report.

  • YouÂ value teamwork, prioritize collaboration, and focus on collective goals and harmony in the workplace.

  • You'reÂ self-motivated, and you loveÂ creative freedom,Â independent judgment, and theÂ responsibilityÂ that comes with both.

  • Youâre driven by the desire toÂ make a positive impact in the worldÂ and to improve the lives of others.

  • If you still love designing in Figma and building interfaces with AI, there's room for that here. Some of our Course Directors design hands-on; others have moved fully into direction. Both work for us.

  • Most of the work happens from yourÂ home office,Â but you'reÂ willing to travel a few times a yearÂ to shoot courses.

  • You're located in aÂ time zoneÂ between UTC-6 (Austin, Chicago) and UTC+8 (Singapore, Perth), which includes all of Europe.

Bonus Points

None of these are required, but each of them would make us even happier.

  • You'veÂ led a design team.

  • YouÂ publish your own thinking on design: articles, a book, educational material, a blog, or a social media presence.

  • You'veÂ spoken at design conferences, or you're on a first-name basis with people who do.

  • You'veÂ created design systems. Organizing complex material so other people can put it to use is a lot of what you'll be doing.

  • You've worked as anÂ editor, or you've createdÂ online courses.

  • You have the graphic design skills to create image-based and interactive content for courses, articles, and social media.

  • You'veÂ built AI-supported learning toolsÂ yourself, or you've used AI to build products.

  • You hold aÂ bachelor's or master'sÂ degree in UX, UI, HCI,Â AI, or a similar field.

  • YouâveÂ collaborated with video production teams.

What We Can Offer

  • A highly valued role: You'll shape our core product, our courses and Master Classes.

  • Reach and impact that are difficult to find anywhere else in this field.Â A design leader might shape the work of thirty people on their team. Your decisions about what we teach will reach hundreds of thousands. They'll build better careers and design a better world for all of us.

  • Access:Â the designers you'd normally see on a conference stage are the people you'll email, plan with, and sit across from in a studio. Our name opens doors. An email from IxDF gets read, so the reach you have now is the floor, not the ceiling.

  • Autonomy: Nobody will ever hand you a template and tell you to fill it in.

  • A global, purpose-driven team: work remotelyÂ alongside passionate professionals from all over the world, united by aÂ common missionÂ to create the best possible design and AI education in the world and make it accessible for everyone.

  • Our co-founder and co-CEO, Rikke, will work closely with you. She and our other co-founder, Mads, built IxDF from nothing, with no investment capital, so we would stay free to make world-class design education affordable to everyone. She was the sole editor and video editor for many of our early years, so she's shaped our course planning, expert interviews, video shoots, and content editing from the inside. She's still hands-on in everything we do, and she still films educational videos herself, in places like the US, the North Pole, and Nepal.

  • AÂ full-time positionÂ within a fully remote organization. Video-based collaboration with your colleagues from elsewhere on the planet, and we get together in person each year, on a team trip or for a studio production.

  • Bi-weeklyÂ knowledge-sharing sessionsÂ and 4 meeting-free days weekly for focused work.

  • A work culture with noÂ fluffy titles, political agendas, or corporate drama. Your colleagues valueÂ your warm character, your strong work ethic, and the results you deliver. If you embody old-school virtues of always striving to deliver results, learn and become better every day, you'll thrive at IxDF.

title: Lead Estimator
description:
About the role

For more than 60 years, Complex has been known for delivering award winning construction projects across the built environment.


Our skillful execution of quality projects is an expression of our personal and professional commitment to connecting and enhancing communities.


We are looking for a Lead Estimator, this role will provide support and technical advice to our estimating team, deliver accurate, competitive, and well-documented cost estimates for civil & construction projects, while also providing oversight and tender coordination to the estimating team.


The Lead Estimator is a critical role that remains hands-on in the preparation of tenders while contributing to pricing strategy, subcontractor engagement, and achieving tendering milestones.


Key responsibilities

  • Prepare detailed cost build-ups, subcontractor comparisons, and pricing reconciliations
  • Analyse historical project data to support pricing accuracy and continuous improvement
  • Promote consistent estimating methodologies, tools, and documentation standards
  • Maintain effective working relationships with key subcontractors and suppliers

About you

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in commercial construction / civil infrastructure estimating
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and leading complex civil tenders
  • Strong understanding of civil, building and construction methodologies, contract review and risk identification, and cost planning and pricing strategy
  • Proven ability to mentor and support junior and mid-level estimators

description:

Description

Job Summary:

The BESS Project Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, and analyzing detailed project schedules for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. This role plays a critical part in ensuring projects are delivered on time by providing accurate schedule forecasts, identifying risks, and supporting project teams with data-driven insights across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and energization phases. This role requires a strong leader that will take ownership of driving accurate and up to date scheduling across multiple projects as well as taking initiative to drive process improvements where there is an opportunity to improve.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules for BESS projects from NTP through COD
  • Build schedules covering engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, civil, electrical, installation, commissioning, and grid interconnection
  • Collaborate with Project Managers, Construction Managers, OEMs, and subcontractors to validate logic, durations, and sequencing
  • Perform critical path analysis, float analysis, and schedule risk assessments
  • Track project progress and update schedules using actuals, forecasts, and recovery plans
  • Identify schedule impacts related to procurement delays, permitting, weather, interconnection, or change orders
  • Prepare schedule narratives, look-ahead schedules, and progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Support claims, change management, and time-impact analyses as required
  • Ensure schedules align with contract milestones, EPC agreements, and owner requirements
  • Maintain schedule standards, templates, and best practices across the portfolio
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Bachelorâs degree in construction management, Engineering, Project Management, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of project scheduling experience in utility-scale energy, power generation, or heavy civil construction
  • Direct experience supporting BESS, solar, wind, or substation projects
  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 (required)
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Excel
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, procurement lead times, and commissioning activities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with EPC contracts and utility-scale energy storage projects
  • Knowledge of battery OEM workflows (manufacturing, FAT, shipping, commissioning)
  • Familiarity with Power BI or other reporting/analytics tools
  • Experience supporting schedule recovery plans and delay analysis
  • Experience developing resource-loaded and cost-loaded schedules
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present schedule data clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Work Environment/Physical Requirements

  • Combination of office, remote, and active construction site environments
  • Ability to work extended hours during critical project phases
  • Working in all weather conditions

  • May require overtime, nights, or weekends based on project needs

Pre-Employment Requirements

Candidates must successfully complete a background check and drug screening prior to hiring. This role is considered safety-sensitive and may be subject to ongoing drug and testing in compliance with company policy and regulatory requirements.

Location: Location specific; travel up to 50%

Reed Recruitment are delighted to be recruiting for one of the UKâs leading multi-discipline Civil Engineering and Building contractors, for a Civils Estimator. This role offers a fantastic opportunity for career development and progression within a dynamic team.

We are looking for an enthusiastic, customer-obsessed Studio Sales Associate to join our team in our Lincoln Park studio location. This position involves assisting customers with ear piercings, providing product recommendations, and ensuring the studio maintains Rowanâs high standards of cleanliness and safety. title: Senior Specialist Global QMS
description:
More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer. While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.


The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. This role will support and lead the internal audit program, supplier management program, and inspection readiness. This role will support the growth and expansion of the global quality program to support manufacturing of our cell therapy products. You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations. Your role will support Orca Bios commercial readiness and ongoing clinical programs by managing and facilitating audits, resolving supplier-related quality issues and interacting with quality management teams at the site levels to ensure consistent application of quality systems across the organization.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Plan, schedule and execute internal audits across all sites and functions in accordance with the internal audit program.
  • Develop audit agenda, conduct interviews, review processes and generate audit reports.
  • Support the global Quality Management Review (QMR) process, ensuring timely data collection, analysis, and reporting to senior leadership.
  • Support the supplier qualification and management program, including risk assessments, supplier audits, and ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance with GxP requirements.
  • Drive global inspection management activities, ensuring cross-functional and site readiness for FDA, EMA, and other health authority inspections.
  • Provide oversight and guidance to site QMR administrators ensuring consistent quality system implementation across all Orca Bio sites.
  • Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance.
  • Partner with IT and business process owners to identify and implement QMS system enhancements, including defining requirements, driving prioritization and ensuring changes are validated and compliant.
  • Review, approve, and provide quality oversight for validation documentation (e.g., equipment qualification, computer system validation, process validation) for global enterprise systems (e.g. MasterControl, ERP systems, Trackwise, etc.) ensuring alignment with regulatory and internal requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional and site leadership teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring the QMS evolves in line with business needs and regulatory expectations.


Experience:
  • Bachelorâs degree in a scientific or engineering discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant Quality Assurance or Quality Systems experience in a GxP-regulated environment, with at least 2-3 years in a leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of global quality regulations and standards (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO 9001, 21 CFR Parts 210/211/820, EU GMP).
  • Proven experience leading Quality Management Review, internal audit programs, supplier management processes, and validation oversight.
  • Demonstrated success in establishing and trending quality performance metrics and KPIs.
  • Experience supporting and/or administering electronic QMS systems and partnering with IT for system enhancements.
  • Experience working in a multi-site or global quality organization strongly preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functional and site boundaries.


\n
$90,000 - $120,000 a year
\n

The anticipated annual salary range for this job is based on prior experience in the role/industry, education, location, internal equity, and other job-related factors as permitted by law. For remote-based positions, this range may vary based on your local market. Full-time employment positions will also be eligible to receive pre-IPO equity and annual bonus, in addition to competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, PTO, 401(k) plan, life and accidental death and disability coverage, and parental leave benefits. Other perks include subsidized daily lunches and snacks at our on-site locations.

description:
Job Description â Quantity Surveyor (QS Engineer)Position

Quantity Surveyor / QS Engineer â Civil Construction

Project: Commercial Hotel Construction Project

Location: Vijayawada / Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh

Site: Daspalla Project Site

Experience: 5+ Years

Employment Type: Full-time, Site-based

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Quantity Surveyor / QS Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in civil/building construction to join the project team for a commercial hotel construction project in Vijayawada/Amaravati.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in quantity estimation, BOQ preparation, rate analysis, measurement, subcontractor billing, client billing, material reconciliation and cost control.

Candidates with experience in commercial buildings, hotels, high-rise buildings or large-scale building projects will be preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and review BOQs, quantity take-offs and estimates for civil and finishing works.
  • Prepare detailed quantity calculations from architectural, structural and MEP drawings.
  • Conduct regular site measurements and maintain accurate measurement records.
  • Prepare and verify contractor/subcontractor bills based on actual site measurements.
  • Review subcontractor RA bills, work orders, measurements and supporting documents.
  • Prepare client bills / RA bills and ensure timely submission.
  • Carry out rate analysis for various civil, structural and finishing items.
  • Monitor project quantities against the BOQ and identify variations.
  • Prepare and maintain variation statements, extra items and deviation statements.
  • Track project costs and assist in maintaining effective cost control.
  • Reconcile quantities of key materials such as cement, steel, concrete and other construction materials.
  • Coordinate with the Project Manager, Site Engineers, Planning Team, Purchase Team, Accounts Team and subcontractors.
  • Check drawings and specifications to identify quantity/cost implications before execution.
  • Maintain proper documentation of measurements, bills, work orders, quotations and quantity records.
  • Assist in preparing project cost forecasts and quantity/progress reports.
  • Support commercial negotiations with subcontractors and vendors when required.
  • Ensure that all billing and measurement documentation is accurate and submitted within project timelines.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Quantity Surveyor / QS Engineer in civil/building construction.
  • Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering or equivalent qualification.
  • Strong knowledge of BOQ preparation, quantity take-off, measurements and billing.
  • Good understanding of civil construction drawings and specifications.
  • Experience in subcontractor billing and client billing.
  • Strong knowledge of rate analysis and cost estimation.
  • Experience handling variation orders, extra items and reconciliation statements.
  • Good knowledge of Excel and quantity/billing-related software.
  • Ability to independently handle QS activities at a project site.
  • Strong analytical and numerical skills.
  • Good coordination and communication skills.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with experience in the following types of projects will be preferred:

  • Hotels / Hospitality Projects
  • Commercial Buildings
  • High-rise Buildings
  • Residential & Commercial Complexes
  • Large-scale Civil Construction Projects

title: Regional Sales Manager - DACH
description:
Build & Lead Our First Team in Region

This is a rare one: the chance to be the founding Sales Manager for Elliptic's DACH region. You won't be inheriting a team or a playbook — you'll be building both. If you want ownership over how a market gets built, not just a territory to run within someone else's structure, this is that role.

As Sales Manager, you'll be a foundational force in building and scaling both new logo acquisition and expansion across DACH. Leading a team of motivated quota-carrying Account Executives that you'll help hire and shape from day one, you'll be accountable for creating an elite sales culture, establishing sales discipline from scratch, and helping your team win complex enterprise deals across high-potential markets.

You will embody what it means to be a bar-raiser — not just holding high standards, but operationalizing them through coaching, process, and execution, in a region where you get to decide what "the way we do things" actually looks like.

What you will do:

Champion Elite Sales Execution

  • Lead from the front by coaching AEs through long, complex enterprise sales cycles — from outbound opportunity generation through to multi-threaded stakeholder engagement, PoCs, and contract negotiation

  • Reinforce a rigorous, AE-led approach to pipeline creation and account strategy

Drive and Scale New Logo Acquisition and Expansion

  • Build and execute the go-to-market strategy for DACH — breaking into high-value accounts across the crypto, fintech, financial services, and regulatory ecosystem

  • Forecast accurately, deliver against team quota, and maximise GTM efficiency in region

Embed Sales Rigour & Methodology

  • Roll out and reinforce powerful sales hygiene — from qualification and forecasting, to next-step discipline and CRM hygiene

  • Act as a process enabler, ensuring not just methodology knowledge, but mastery in execution underpinning MEDDPICC and Value-Based Selling

  • Leverage AI-powered sales tools to support qualification, pipeline health, and deal strategy execution

Coach, Develop & Elevate the Team

  • Continuously coach on core sales motions: outbound prospecting, access to power, objection handling, discovery quality, and deal closing

  • Provide real-time feedback via call coaching, pipeline reviews, and deal strategy sessions

  • Help AEs progress their careers while outperforming targets

  • Encourage the thoughtful application of AI tools within the sales process, fostering a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement

  • Incorporate AI-driven insights and capabilities into seller workflows to enhance productivity, improve win rates, and shorten sales cycles

Accelerate Strategic Proof-of-Concept Motions

  • Elevate the team's handling of Proofs of Concept and Trial cycles — ensuring AEs & SEs collaborate, and deliver customised demonstrations

  • Partner with pre-sales to deliver exceptional buying experiences

Orchestrate Cross-Functional Success

  • Steer/support the sales team in leading a cross-functional deal squad to ensure a smooth and high-velocity deal cycle

  • Feed voice-of-customer insights back into GTM leadership and Product — with an outsized voice given you're shaping how we enter this market

Build a High-Performance Culture

  • Create psychological safety and accountability through inclusion, transparency, and trust

  • Set the tone for excellence, energy, and ethical ambition — within your team and cross-regionally

  • Hire, onboard, and retain exceptional talent, building the DACH team from the ground up

  • Promote AI literacy and usage best practices across the team to drive innovation, reduce cognitive load, and support data-informed decision-making

title: Chemical Laboratory Assistant / Lab Technician (f/m/d) Analytics & Synthesis
description:
Your mission

Join aevoloop, a deep-tech startup in Leipzig, where we are pioneering the next generation of circular plastics. We are looking for a hands-on Chemical Technical Assistant (CTA) or Lab Technician who takes pride in their lab work. In this role, your primary focus will be on the precise "measuring" (analytics) of our materials, while reliably supporting the team with "making" (synthesis).

  • Analytics & Characterization: You are the analytical core of our lab. You routinely perform instrumental and wet-chemical analyses to precisely characterisze our next-generation materials (e.g., NMR, IR spectroscopy, DSC, titrations).

  • Synthesis Execution: You support syntheses (specifically polycondensations) on a bench and pilot scale, reliably and accurately executing reactions according to established standard operating procedures (SOPs).

  • Daily Lab Routine & Excellence: You ensure smooth lab operations. This includes preparing and maintaining glassware, sample preparation, material drying, and general lab organization.

  • Precision & Documentation: You ensure our measurement data is rock-solid. This includes regular calibration of analytical instruments, maintaining detailed lab journals, and assisting in drafting clear SOPs.

  • Safety & Organization: You maintain a safe, high-standard working environment (GLP) and ensure analytical equipment is always ready for the next run.


Your profile

  • Education: Successfully completed vocational training as a CTA (Chemical Technical Assistant), Chemielaborant, or a similar technical background. Academic degrees or Techniker qualifications are considered, but this is a hands-on technical role where practical bench experience is our top priority.

  • Analytical Expertise: Strong practical experience in general instrumental and wet-chemical analytics (especially NMR, IR, DSC, titration). Experience in specialized polymer testing (e.g., MFR/MFI, tensile testing) or prior experience in a plastics laboratory is a major plus!

  • Synthesis Experience: Experience in carrying out organic syntheses safely according to protocol (SOPs). Specialized knowledge of polymers or reactors is advantageous, but not mandatory—we are happy to train you.

  • Technical Routine: You feel "at home" in the lab. You are confident operating analytical instruments, preparing samples, and performing routine instrument calibrations.

  • Mindset: You bring a "maker" mentality. You are detail-oriented, reliable, and enjoy the dynamic, collaborative energy of a scaling startup.

  • Languages: Working knowledge of English (sufficient for technical documentation and day-to-day team communication) is required. German is a plus, but not necessary.


Why us?

  • Real Impact: Help redesign plastics for a truly circular economy.

  • Startup Mindset: Flat hierarchies, fast decisions and early responsibility as we scale.

  • Team Culture: Join a team of curious minds that challenge each other, collaborate openly and celebrate progress together.

  • Growth & Learning: Steep learning curves, regular feedback and room to grow with the company.

  • Well-being Perks – Hansefit membership and fresh snacks and beverages your overall health and well-being.

title: Enterprise Account Executive

description:
Senior Solutions Engineer — EMEA

At Phrase, we help open the door to global business by providing the world's leading Language Intelligence Platform.

The Phrase Platform combines AI, agentic orchestration, and a headless, API-first architecture in one composable system. Beyond translation, it orchestrates and adapts content to culture, audience, channel, brand voice, and intended outcome in any language, for every audience. It applies the context that makes content perform in every market: quality standards, glossaries, prior translations, and cultural nuance. Every team, in every region, can ship content that is on-brand, on-point, and ready for any audience.

Phrase gives enterprises the intelligence to automate workflows, the freedom to connect their own tools and engines, and the control to govern global content at scale.

With a global team based in our offices, and remote colleagues across Europe, the UK, the US, and the APAC region, Phrase offers an international environment built on collaboration, innovation, and shared purpose.

This is a senior individual contributor role, reporting to the VP of Solutions Engineering. You will be working hand in hand with Enterprise AEs across EMEA, running discovery, building the business case and delivering demos and Proof of Value workshops that actually connect to what's keeping a customer's business up at night.

We're building an AI-first pre-sales organisation where continuous improvement is part of everyone's role. You'll be encouraged to challenge how things are done, use AI and automation to remove repetitive work and help create smarter ways of working for the whole team. If your instinct is to ask "there must be a better way" and then go and build it, you'll thrive here.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Run technical discovery across a portfolio of EMEA enterprise opportunities and find the business impact that sits beyond the localization workflow

  • Build demos tailored to the prospect, their industry and the people in the room, not a generic script

  • Translate what the platform does into outcomes a VP or C-level buyer actually cares about

  • Partner with AEs on deal strategy, RFP/RFI responses and competitive positioning

  • Own POCs and POVs end to end: scope them properly, run them and prove the value, not just the functionality

  • Continuously improve how we work by using AI, automation and new technologies to remove repetitive tasks and create better ways of working.

  • Challenge existing processes, experiment with new ideas and help shape the tools and practices the whole team uses.

  • Feed competitive intel and win/loss insight back to Product and Sales leadership.

  • Work closely with our Product team to influence and set the direction of the platform

  • Be in front of customers and represent Phrase at events across EMEA

  • Share what you know. We run an SE culture where the ability to work as a team and support others is a requirement

  • Help mentor other SEs and the rest of the GTM team as we grow the enterprise motion

What you'll need

  • Solid experience (at least 5 years) in pre-sales, solutions engineering or solutions consulting, ideally in language, localization or content tech

  • A real understanding of how localization teams operate, what pressure they're under commercially and who signs off the budget

  • The range to run a discovery call with a CMO as comfortably as with a localization lead

  • Good commercial instinct. Reading the room, adapting your message and knowing when to push and when to sit back

  • Experience selling into or supporting enterprise accounts in EMEA. APAC exposure is a bonus, not a requirement

  • The ability to use AI tools extensively, as part of how you work, not just to chat

  • Fluent German strongly preferred, other European languages welcome

  • A team-first mindset. We operate a team culture that is incredibly open and supportive. There are no individual heroes here.

  • Time at an LSP, localization tech vendor or enterprise software company in a commercial-facing role is a plus

  • CS or implementation background with strong commercial exposure also considered

 

What you'll get:

• Work at a successful and growing global SaaS company

• Be part of an international team in Europe, APAC and the Americas

• Expert colleagues in their field who are determined to build the best localization platform in the market, creating a world where language never limits opportunity

• An agile work environment, where it is encouraged to take smart risks

• Take part in a culture full of trust, support and loyalty, where respectful and open feedback is valued and diversity is fully embraced

• A positive, open-minded, and innovative atmosphere

• Support in your professional development and personal career goals

 

What's on top:

• 4 Company holidays additional to your regular holidays (1 day per quarter where the entire company is off to celebrate our achievements).

• In addition, the company also provides employees with a Christmas break to allow you to spend time with family and friends without use of your vacation allocation.

• Your birthday is off because it is important to celebrate you as well.

• 2 Giveback days where you can support the local community, volunteer, and/or participate in charity events and activities.

• Professional and extensive onboarding.

• Enterprise Claude Licence

• Additional local benefits depending on the entity in which you are hired, just ask your Talent Acquisition Partner

description:
About iSpeedToLead

iSpeedToLead is the leading pay-per-lead marketplace for real estate wholesalers, investors, and agents in the US. We sell motivated seller leads with no subscriptions and no contracts. Bootstrapped, profitable, $15M+ ARR, ~50 people across Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and the US. We move fast, we measure everything, and we are building for a much bigger outcome.

Why this role exists

The CEO is doing two jobs: setting strategy and running day-to-day operations. Your job is to take the second one and run it better than he does. You own execution across the whole company so the CEO can focus on product vision, new verticals, and growth bets.

• The operating system of the company: department goals, KPIs, weekly scoreboards, and accountability across Supply, Demand, and Marketplace teams

• P&L discipline: unit economics per department, cost caps, and a clear path to our monthly net profit target

• Hiring and org design as we scale into new lead verticals (insurance, loans)

• Every department runs on 2 KPIs with guardrails, reviewed weekly

• You have run operations at a proptech or marketplace company doing $10M+ in annual revenue. This is a hard requirement

title: Publishing Product Director
description:
As Publishing Product Director, you are the creative custodian of one of Crytek’s games, embedded inside the game team, accountable for protecting the creative vision and translating the promise of the game into work that the publishing team can execute with conviction. The success of a great game depends on the work that surrounds it landing as truthfully as the game itself, and closing that gap is what this role exists to do. You make sure that what reaches players is authentic, aspirational, tells the story the game deserves, and delights the players who play it. 

The game in your remit is an unannounced project in the Crytek portfolio. The work focuses on shaping the project’s player promise from the inside out, defining the publishing narrative for its eventual reveal, and carrying its creative vision through to launch and into ongoing releases. 

You sit inside the game team, working shoulder-to-shoulder with game leadership every day. You partner directly with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to support both the game and the business as one connected effort. You are the direct line between the game team and the publishing organization, the person who protects the north star on both ends, and the person both sides trust to tell them the truth. 

This role demands creative conviction, drive, and the kind of experience that only comes from working shoulder-to-shoulder with game teams. You will protect the team from noise so they can build the game, and you will give the publishing team the clarity, player insight, and creative truth they need to land it well. It is one of the most consequential seats at Crytek, and one of the most rewarding. 


What You'll Do
  • Be the custodian of the game’s creative vision, tone, and player promise, and translate it into work that publishing can execute with conviction
  • Sit embedded inside the game team and act as the daily bridge between game leadership and the publishing organisation  
  • Serve as the source of truth on what the game is, what is coming next, and what it means for players, across Marketing, Comms, Community, and Commercial  
  • Brief and review every major marketing, comms, and community output for creative authenticity, ensuring it tells the right player story  
  • Partner with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to shape go-to-market plans that serve the game and the business in equal measure  
  • Drive franchise narrative, player promise, and creative direction across reveals, beats, and post-launch moments  
  • Protect the game team from operational noise so they can focus on building, while translating publishing priorities into work the team can act on  
  • Keep the north star intact on both ends, keeping publishing grounded in the game’s vision, and the game team grounded in player and market reality  

    • What You Bring
  • 8+ years working at the seam between game development and publishing or marketing, with significant time embedded inside game teams
  • Proven ability to translate creative vision into commercial activation without compromising either side, with strong creative judgement and editorial instinct you can defend under pressure  
  • Fluency across business models (premium, live service, DLC, F2P) and multi-year roadmap strategy, and how the two shape the player promise  
  • Cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence without authority across game and publishing teams  
  • Strong player insight, audience segmentation, and community fluency  
  • Drive and operating range, comfortable moving from creative critique in the morning to commercial trade-offs in the afternoon  
  • Experience supporting or launching at least one major game or live-service title from inside the game team  
  • Track record of being trusted by both game leadership and publishing leadership  

    • What you can expect from us

    Career Path 
    Your professional development is important to us, so we have laid out a career plan to help you progress towards your goals and objectives. 
     
    Relocation Support

    Gym Card 
    A healthy body is a healthy mind. We offer a membership at the premium gym chain Fitness First in Germany. Work out, join group fitness classes, or relax in the wellness facilities.
     
    State-of-the-art Office
    We’ve recently moved into a brand-new, modern office located in the heart of Frankfurt. Our new workspace is designed to inspire creativity and collaboration, with open areas, quiet zones, and top-tier facilities — all just steps away from public transport, restaurants, bars and cultural hotspots.

    We believe in the value of in-person collaboration while also supporting flexibility. Our hybrid working model includes three days per week in the office and the option to work remotely up to two days per week, unless role-specific requirements or business needs require you to be on site.

Knit - Research Manager
description:
Knit is the AI-native consumer research platform helping brands automate and accelerate primary research. With our Researcher-Driven AI, we’ve condensed the entire quant + qual research process from weeks into days (sometimes hours!) for 50+ enterprise brands — including Amazon, T-Mobile, Mars, NASCAR, and more. We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible.


Overview

The purpose of the Research Manager role is to ensure Knit customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their partnerships with Knit. By owning and supporting customer relationships, getting deeply engrained in customer research needs, and driving high-quality project deliverables, the Research Manager’s impact is ultimately measured by positive customer retention.

Responsibilities:

The research function is a primary contributor to Knit’s shared business objectives of customer retention and upsells, ultimately measured by Net Revenue Retention (NRR) in addition to supporting successful Pilot to Subscription Conversions for acquiring new business.

The levers the Research Manager role owns to influence these key business objectives are:

  • Research Success → Ensuring Knit Customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their projects with Knit, measured by successfully achieving Research Objectives and delivering on Knit’s Quality & Speed service-level agreements (SLA’s)

Primary responsibilities of this role:

  • Serving as the dedicated research lead for all customers’ projects (on assigned accounts) and serving as the ultimate accountable part for research project success

  • Driving and documenting in-depth project scoping to uncover a deep understanding of research objectives and project context to set up project success

  • Demonstrate a growth mindset as a solutions architect for customers, educating them on Knit’s research capabilities, consulting with them to adjust for fringe requirements, and proposing solutions to maximize project success - escalating to Research Directors when needs exceed capabilities

  • Escalating needs to Research Directors to support troubleshooting when increased risk for project viability or customer impact occurs

  • Driving, maintaining, and enriching all customer context to improve Knit’s ability to meet the customers’ custom research needs

  • Being the final, customer-ready check and approver on all Knit final topline delivery and presenting the key insights and recommendations directly to the customers

  • Participating in continuous innovation on Knit’s AI product to minimize the delta between Knit’s AI output and a human researcher output

  • Driving on feedback collection on “the last mile” - uncovering and documenting what happens after Knit delivers a project to when it’s “stakeholder ready,” supporting Knit’s product vision in getting to stakeholder ready reports

Required Skills & Experiences:

  • Must have 5+ years of market research experience, with the majority of the time spent on the supplier side in a market research agency environment.

  • Must have experience leading discovery and scoping calls, writing and editing quant and qual questionnaires from scratch, drafting analysis plans, and creating and presenting stakeholder-ready insights topline & reports.

  • Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes in ambiguous environments, both for navigating complex customer needs and Knit internal business changes. Proven track record successfully operating in an early stage startup (<50 employees) is a plus.

  • Proven track record of owning and supporting client relationships with customers at Enterprise, Fortune 500 US-based companies, specifically working with insights professionals to scope and achieve desired research outcomes, resulting in customer retention and growth.

  • Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes successfully in environments with competing priorities, multiple research projects on at a given time, and simultaneous internal business demands.

Benefits

Upon joining the Knit team, you will receive a competitive salary + commission plan if applicable to role, Equity Options, Healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), and Additional Coverage, a company laptop and one-time, onboarding Technology Stipend, a 401(k) with company match, flexible time-off, hybrid working, and more!

Salary

In accordance with New York pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role is $115,000 - $130,000. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s level, experience, and qualifications upon joining Knit.

Our Company Values

We are the Championship Team. This means we:

  • Are 1% better every day: We approach situations with a growth mindset and ask, “How can we make the business better?” and “What would it take?”

  • Play to win: We set audacious goals and push ourselves to achieve them with a bias towards action (When we see a need, we take initiative, and hold ourselves accountable to seeing it through).

  • Keep the main thing the main thing: Identify what has the biggest impact and prioritize to focus on it.

description:
Job Description About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the U.S., connecting over 14 million Gen Z students with private scholarships — and the brands that power them. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

The Role

Reports to: Director of Sales

Compensation: Strong base salary + uncapped commission structure with clear accelerators for over-performance.

We are looking for a proactive, results-oriented Account Executive (Full Cycle) to take strong ownership of our revenue growth through consistent, targeted outbound prospecting and strategic closing. This is a high-impact, mid-to-senior level role designed for a true "hunter" who thrives on turning cold opportunities into high-quality, long-term B2B clients for our SSC and Pro product lines.

This role runs in two gears: sharp and disciplined in creating pipeline — targeted, creative outbound to a defined ICP, disciplined qualification, and efficiently filtering out deals that aren't a fit — and consultative once you're in the room, where discovery and product education come before the pitch and multi-stakeholder deals are won on understanding, not pressure.

In this role, you won't just wait for inbound leads—you will own the entire sales lifecycle. From dedicated outbound prospecting and strategic qualification to leading compelling product demos and closing complex deals, you will drive the pipeline that fuels our expansion. If you are motivated by building a robust book of business from scratch and find purpose in driving net-new revenue, you’ll thrive in this position.

What You'll Be Selling

  • Sponsored Scholarship Campaigns (SSC) — Our flagship product, and a performance marketing channel rather than a philanthropy program. It's built on the foundation of something Gen Z is already looking for: scholarships, not ads. The brand earns the next generation of customers, and students earn financial aid. We build the campaign with the client and run the scholarship end to end, so the brand reaches a US Gen Z audience through a channel that's permission-based by design rather than interruptive, and generates first-party, opt-in insights at scale.

    • What that solves varies by client, and learning to read which version you're selling is a real part of the job: customer and user acquisition, lead generation, recruiting pipeline, content, or serious brand engagement with the next generation of buyers. Your buyer is typically a Growth Manager or marketing lead at a brand or agency that sells to Gen Z, and you're competing for performance marketing budget against paid social and search, not against other scholarship platforms.

  • ScholarshipOwl Pro — Scholarship management for organizations already running their own scholarship programs in cumbersome or inefficient ways: shorter cycle, more operational, philanthropic buyer, and a second motion alongside SSC.

What You’ll Do

  • Relentless Prospecting: Execute high-volume daily outbound campaigns (calls, emails, LinkedIn) to hunt for net-new opportunities and consistently book discovery meetings.

  • Full-Cycle Ownership: Run the entire sales process from initial cold outreach and aggressive qualification to running product demos, sending proposals, and closing deals.

  • Data-Driven Pipeline Triage: Actively manage your sales funnel within HubSpot, performing regular pipeline reviews to prioritize high-value opportunities and ruthlessly cut weak leads.

  • Drive Revenue & Velocity: Take absolute ownership of your targets, driving urgency in deal cycles to progress opportunities through late-stage negotiations and contract signing.

  • Hit Major Milestones: Our sales cycle runs four to six months, so your first quarter is about building. Deliver $175–300K in qualified pipeline (approx. 20–30 qualified meetings) in your first 90 days, and close your first net-new deal within six months.

  • Iterate & Optimize: Continuously refine your outreach messaging and campaign targeting based on performance metrics to maximize conversion rates.



What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves

  • 3+ Years of B2B Sales Experience: A proven track record of exceeding quotas in a full-cycle B2B sales or business development role (prospecting through to close).

  • "Hunter" Mentality & Dialing Discipline: You have a high drive, resilience in the face of rejection, and a proven daily discipline for outbound cold calling.

  • Pipeline Mastery: Strong proficiency with HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) paired with immaculate data hygiene, accurate notes, and clear deal-stage tracking.

  • Exceptional Execution: Proven ability to run tight discovery calls, command proposal conversations, control the sales narrative, and push multi-stakeholder deals across the finish line.

  • Communication Excellence: Advanced English proficiency with exceptional presentation and relationship-building skills across phone, Zoom, email, and Slack.

Bonus Points

  • Experience using advanced outbound workflows or AI-driven discovery tools like Clay.

  • Familiarity with mid-market sales cycles (4–6 months) involving multi-stakeholder decision-making.

  • A background working within high-growth startup or fast-paced SMB environments.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Educational Foundation: Holds a Bachelor’s degree (though we highly value proven sales grit and revenue results over formal education).

  • Targeted Industry Experience: Experience selling into Directors, CMOs, Growth, or Brand leaders—ideally within marketing, lead generation, digital acquisition, or performance models.

  • U.S. Market Exposure: Familiarity with U.S. business culture, the U.S. education/scholarship landscape, or holding a degree from a U.S.-based institution.

  • Strategic Traits: A natural curiosity to uncover deeper customer needs and the strategic thinking required to prioritize high-value enterprise or agency opportunities.

Why Join ScholarshipOwl?

  • Mission-Driven Work: Build technology that helps students unlock education opportunities and reduce financial barriers.

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world while collaborating with a global team. (Note: This role requires overlapping with standard U.S. working hours for client meetings).

  • High Impact & Ownership: You aren't just a cog in a machine; you own your domain and directly drive results.

  • Unlimited PTO: We value outcomes over hours worked and trust you to manage your time.

  • Computer Upgrade Budget: Up to $1,600 to invest in your ideal primary work computer.

  • Workspace Upgrade Program: Up to $800 to set up your home office.

  • Monthly Coworking Allowance: $200/month to rent desks or workspace passes whenever you want a change of scenery.

  • Owl Shine Program: Monthly employee recognition and awards celebrating extraordinary contributions.

  • Continuous Learning Culture: Dedicated support for curiosity, bold experimentation, and career growth.

  • Annual Global Off-sites: Connect with your teammates in person at exciting locations

description:
Persönlichkeit – Engagement – Innovation!​

In der AppFactory bei GRAYOAK entstehen innovative, cloud-agnostische Softwarelösungen für kritische Infrastrukturen und hochsensible Betriebsumgebungen. Unsere Anwendungen werden für den sicheren Einsatz in der Cloud, On-Premise sowie in Air-Gapped-Umgebungen entwickelt.
 
Informationssicherheit, Compliance, Datenhoheit und Resilienz sind dabei feste Bestandteile unserer Architektur- und Entwicklungsprozesse. In interdisziplinären Teams begleiten wir unsere Kunden von der Konzeption über die sichere Umsetzung bis zum zuverlässigen produktiven Betrieb.
 
Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf verlässlichen Build-, Test- und Release-Prozessen: Deployments werden automatisiert, saubere Pipelines etabliert und neue Versionen schnell, sicher und nachvollziehbar ausgeliefert. Die Rolle konzipiert Release- und Deployment-Architekturen, die sich flexibel an unterschiedliche Kundenumgebungen anpassen lassen, und fungiert als technischer Ansprechpartner für Entwicklungs- und Produktteams.


Von der Theorie zur Praxis – bring Dein Wissen ins Spiel!

  • Konzipieren, Aufbauen und Betreiben von CI/CD-Pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) – für schnelle, stabile und wiederholbare Software-Releases in Produktion
  • Automatisieren von Build-, Test- und Deployment-Prozessen sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Release-Qualität und -Geschwindigkeit
  • Gestalten und Pflegen von Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep) für Azure-Umgebungen sowie aktives Vorantreiben des Shift-Left-Ansatzes
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungs-, Test- und Betriebsteams sowie Etablieren von DevOps-Best-Practices in der AppFactory
  • Umsetzen moderner Deployment-Strategien (Blue/Green, Canary, Rolling) und Begleiten interner sowie kundenseitiger Projekte bei der technischen Umsetzung
  • Analysieren von Incidents im Release-Prozess, Identifizieren von Schwachstellen und Entwickeln nachhaltiger Lösungen gemeinsam mit dem Team
  • Beraten von Kunden bei der Konzeption geeigneter Release- und Deployment-Architekturen sowie gezieltes Matchen der Anforderungen mit dem GRAYOAK-Lösungsportfolio
  • Übernehmen einer aktiven Architekturrolle im Kundenprojekt – von der Anforderungsanalyse über die Lösungskonzeption bis zur begleitenden technischen Umsetzung
  • Fungieren als technischer Ansprechpartner für Release- und Deployment-Fragen – intern für Entwicklungs- und Produktteams sowie extern für Kunde


Deine Skills, Dein Potenzial – das suchen wir!​

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation bzw. entsprechende praktische Erfahrung
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Release Engineering, DevOps oder CI/CD-Engineering – idealerweise im Beratungs- oder Produktumfeld
  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Git, Branching- und Tagging-Strategien
  • Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt oder in beratender Funktion – z.B. als Solution Engineer, Technical Consultant oder in einer ähnlichen Rolle
  • Kommunikationsstärke gegenüber technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern – Fähigkeit, komplexe Architekturen verständlich zu erklären
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in CI/CD-Tooling: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions oder vergleichbar
  • Verständnis von Release-Promotion-Prozessen (Development → Test → Pre-Production → Production) sowie von Hotfix- und Release-Strategien
  • Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code (Terraform und/oder Bicep/ARM)
  • Erfahrung mit Kubernetes-Deployment- und Rollback-Prozessen, Artifact-Management sowie Container-Image-Versionierung (Docker, AKS)
  • Vertrautheit mit unterschiedlichen Systemarchitekturen: Monolith, Monorepo-Strukturen, Multi-Tier sowie Microservices
  • Kenntnisse in Cloud-Architekturen, bevorzugt Microsoft Azure
  • Selbstständige, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch und Hands-on-Mentalität
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
Pluspunkte!
  • Versionierung von Helm Charts sowie GitOps-Workflows (z.B. Argo CD, Flux) und Erfahrung in agilen Entwicklungsumgebungen (Scrum, SAFe)
  • Monitoring & Observability: Azure Monitor, Grafana oder Prometheus
  • Azure- oder DevOps-Zertifizierungen (z.B. AZ-400, AZ-104)


Individuell stark, gemeinsam unschlagbar – das ist GRAYOAK​

  • Unsere Werte: Wir stehen für Wirksamkeit, Nachhaltigkeit und Technologie als Werttreiber – mit 100% Persönlichkeit, Engagement und Innovation, aber 0% unnötigem Schnickschnack
  • Dein Einstieg: Startklar ab Tag 1 mit IT-Equipment und einem coolen GRAYOAK-Merch-Paket 
  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Arbeite hybrid – im Büro oder im Homeoffice – und passe deine Arbeitszeiten flexibel an deine Lebenssituation an
  • Wohlfühl-Standorte: Moderne Büros in zentraler Lage in Frankfurt am Main oder Berlin, ideal angebunden und bequem gestaltet
  • Lernen und Wachsen: Nutze die Chance, praktische Erfahrungen in spannenden Projekten zu sammeln und deine Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln
  • Teamspirit: Freue dich auf regelmäßige Team-Events, Afterworks und Networking-Möglichkeiten, um Teil unserer lebendigen Unternehmenskultur zu werden


Dein direkter Draht zu uns – wir beantworten gerne deine Fragen!

Irina Köhler

About us

Trexo Robotics is enabling mobility by building powered wearable robots. Our first product is a robot for children with movement disorders such as Cerebral Palsy, and it allows kids to walk, in many cases, for the first time in their lives. The device is currently being used by hundreds of families and the best hospitals across North America.

We are constantly working towards building mobility solutions for all. At Trexo Robotics, you will find a flat organization where you can work with highly optimistic, low ego, and exceptionally talented individuals who look forward to solving hard problems.

About the job

We are growing our presence in the UK and are looking for a Clinical Specialist to join our team as our second UK-based hire. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for a clinician who is passionate about paediatric rehabilitation, technology and making a meaningful difference for children and their families.

As a Clinical Specialist, you will be a key point of contact for families, clinicians and healthcare partners using Trexo. You will lead customer onboarding and training, provide ongoing clinical and technical support, and deliver hands-on device trials at roadshows, conferences and other events.

The role involves significant travel, primarily across the UK and occasionally elsewhere in Europe. We expect travel to account for approx. 75% of your working time. Occasional weekend work may be required for customer trials, roadshows or events. We will provide reasonable notice wherever possible.

What you'll do

  • Lead onboarding and hands-on training for new families and clinical partners receiving their Trexo devices.

  • Provide ongoing support to customers through regular check-ins, helping them use the device effectively and work towards meaningful goals.

  • Conduct hands-on Trexo trials with children and families at roadshows, conferences and other events across the UK and Europe.

  • Address daily customer queries via dedicated chat groups and manage support tickets.

  • Independently set up, adjust, and troubleshoot the Trexo device, including basic technical, mechanical, and software checks.

  • Work with families and clinicians to establish meaningful goals and monitor relevant measures and progress.

  • Gather customer feedback to share with engineering and product teams to drive continuous product improvement.

We are looking for a tech-savvy Physiotherapist who is comfortable working independently with advanced robotic equipment. You bring clinical credibility, strong emotional intelligence, and a practical approach to hands-on problem-solving. You thrive in community-based environments and enjoy traveling to work directly with children and their families.

You are practical and curious. You love asking 'why' multiple times until you understand something from first principles, and you thrive in unknown situations where you can apply logical reasoning, find solutions, and lead.

Most importantly, you are motivated by the opportunity to use technology to improve mobility and quality of life for children.

  • At least 3 years' post-qualification experience working as a Physiotherapist or in a closely related clinical role.

  • Qualification as a Physiotherapist with current HCPC registration (or eligible to practice as a UK-licensed PT).

  • Clinical experience at a level broadly equivalent to NHS Band 6, or equivalent experience in private or independent practice.

  • Experience working in paediatric physiotherapy, ideally in a community-based setting.

  • Tech-savvy with the confidence to independently set up, adjust, and troubleshoot technical equipment.

  • Willingness and ability to travel extensively, with approximately 75% travel across the UK and occasional travel elsewhere in Europe.

Nice to Have

  • Experience providing virtual care, telehealth or remote clinical support.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
JOB SUMMARY

More in Common is looking for a Chief of Staff.  This is a new role and a rare opportunity to help shape the next phase of a fast-growing global organisation working on some of the most urgent issues of our time, working at the CEO's side with a unique vantage point across our country teams, strategy and network of funders and partners worldwide.
(Please note that the preferred London location is for ease of communication with Tim Dixon, who is based in the UK. The postholder will not be involved in the day-to-day polling and research activities of More in Common UK, and will not report or routinely provide support to our Executive Director in the UK, Luke Tryl.)


ABOUT MORE IN COMMON

More in Common is a nonprofit dedicated to understanding the dynamics of polarisation, and identifying solutions that can strengthen social cohesion and confidence in democracy. We help leaders navigate the dynamics of polarisation more effectively, find common ground and bring people together to address shared challenges. More in Common's work is frequently featured in media and used by leaders in government, nonprofits, philanthropy, education, the arts and business. 
 
We have a country-led model, with work deeply rooted in national contexts and led by country directors in each of our seven countries, with a total headcount approaching 100. Our teams generate research insights, translate them into thought leadership, and disseminate and implement them across a wide ecosystem of partners and stakeholders. We hold relationships with leaders in many sectors of society, across politics, media, business, civil society, philanthropy, culture and faith, and from national leaders to local community groups. Recent work has produced fresh insights into public attitudes on immigration, online safety, nature and the energy transition, Ukraine, and democracy.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

This is a rare opportunity to help shape the next phase of a fast-growing global organisation working on some of the most urgent issues of our time, working at the CEO's side with a unique vantage point across our country teams, strategy and network of funders and partners worldwide. 
 
The Chief of Staff is a new role, created as More in Common transitions from its founding phase, when the organisation was led by its co-founders, to sole CEO leadership. It incorporates a senior adviser role, in which the Chief of Staff will be the principal aide, advisor and coordinator to the global CEO Tim Dixon, ensuring priorities advance, decisions move efficiently and commitments are executed. The Chief of Staff will also act as organisational glue: working closely with More in Common’s team of country leaders and directors, ensuring alignment between country executive directors, the global team and the CEO around More in Common's strategy, programmes and operations, and helping spot and resolve problems before they escalate.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategy

  • Strategic counsel: Trusted thought partner to the CEO on strategy and major decisions, drawing on visibility across the whole organisation and ensuring alignment within its country-led model. 
  • CEO communications: Shapes the CEO’s internal and external communications, and absorbs the coordination, communication, and follow-through work that would otherwise pull the CEO away from key public-facing responsibilities.
 
Organisational coordination
  • CEO workflow: Manages the CEO's priorities, time and decision pipeline with the Senior Executive Coordinator, so the right issues get attention and decisions don't stall. 
  • Team alignment and delivery: Keeps global and country teams aligned on shared priorities, facilitates decision-making across the organisation, and leads special projects requiring senior-level attention.
 
Leadership 
  • Country ED support: Liaises with country Executive Directors on the CEO's behalf, identifying where teams need more support and providing assistance in crises. 
  • Talent and succession: Supports leadership succession planning and mentors emerging leaders across country teams.


QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

We are looking for a candidate with:

  • Commitment to More in Common’s mission and values.
  • Experience working closely with, or in direct support of, a senior executive, founder or CEO.
  • Exceptional organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders and time-sensitive decisions simultaneously. 
  • Sound judgement and discretion, including experience handling sensitive or confidential matters. 
  • Comfortable operating with incomplete information, and confident making calls on when to resolve issues independently versus escalate. 
  • The ability to lead through influence rather than authority, working effectively with peers and country teams who have their own mandates and priorities.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to synthesise complex information for diverse audiences.
  • Inter-disciplinary interests and experience, such as having worked in different sectors (business, government, nonprofit), countries and roles. 
  • Fluency in English and at least one of French, German, Spanish, Polish or Portuguese languages.
  • At least six years’ working experience in such fields as public opinion research, public policy, political science, and international relations.


OTHER INFORMATION

More in Common intentionally invests time, energy, and resources in nurturing a distinctive values-driven culture. This culture defines how we work together as a team and with others:

  • Humble, ambitious and generous
  • Rigour and excellence in everything we do
  • Driven by the common good, not by ideology or partisanship
  • Deep curiosity about people, and a commitment to elevating others’ views, particularly those whose voices are largely unheard
  • Firmly rooted in each of our national contexts but curious about the world beyond
  • Valuing diversity of thought, allowing our own beliefs to be challenged and embracing healthy disagreement
  • Embracing a dual role as both sense-makers and change-makers
  • Valuing courage and risk-taking
  • Embracing learning and innovation, and always looking for new paths to make a difference
  • Engaging others from a starting point of trust
  • Drawing from a wide range of backgrounds, worldviews, identities and life experiences
  • Believing in the power of a good laugh and being a great place to work.


COMPENSATION AND CONDITIONS

  • Competitive salary related to location, and excellent benefits along with generous leave and family policy 
  • Some regular international travel
  • Personal learning budget
  • Working in one of our country offices, with a preference for London as our CEO is most often there


DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

We believe our impact can be greater if our team reflects a broad range of social and cultural backgrounds, beliefs, political persuasions and life experiences. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive team.


DEADLINES AND HOW TO APPLY

The deadline to apply is August 31, 2026. Interested candidates should include a CV and a cover letter explaining your personal reasons for wanting to work at More in Common, in this role. A strong cover letter reflects the kind of attention we try to bring to our work - original, insightful and personalised. We want to hear something that only you could tell us, without AI assistance.
